issues.description: Farm.animals is specified in the UML/problem statement as a List<Animal> implemented with an ArrayList, but the reference solution declares it as Set<Animal> and initializes it with a HashSet. This changes required collection semantics (ordering and allowing duplicates) and can make the verse order in singFarmSong() non-deterministic compared to what students implement from the statement/UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the specification by changing Farm to use `private List<Animal> animals = new ArrayList<>();` (update imports, getter/setter types, and keep `addAnimal` as `animals.add(animal)`). Alternatively, if Set behavior is intended, update the UML and problem statement to specify Set/HashSet and clarify ordering is not guaranteed.
